value:
Thou who for our sake wast born of a Virgin, and didst suffer crucifixion, O good One, and didst
despoil death through Death, and as God didst reveal Resurrection; despise not those whom Thou
hast created with Thine own hand; show forth Thy love for mankind, O merciful one; accept the
intercession of Thy Mother, the Theotokos, for us; and save Thy despairing people, O our Savior.
